rules.claim: Every decision that invites maintainer input MUST publish its review window when it opens (recorded in PR description, ADR frontmatter, or announcement).
The forfeiture rule applies to every decision-maker including the BDFL; no exemption for the project lead.

Silence within the scope-appropriate timeframe forfeits the right to weigh in; retroactive objection after the window is not honored, and reopening a decision because someone wishes they had spoken up is not a valid rationale.
Extension requests must be made before the original window expires; extensions requested after expiry are not honored.
The proposer may not set a shorter window than the default for the decision's category without unanimous maintainer-team agreement.
